author: b. t. santiago
title: North Carolina defeats Liberty 11-6 in softball game at Kamphuis Field
text:
Liberty University fell to North Carolina in an 11-6 softball game on March 31 at Kamphuis Field at Liberty Softball Stadium. Both teams hit three home runs each, but the Tar Heels managed to secure the win.
The outcome moves North Carolina to a season record of 25-9, while Liberty drops to 16-18. The game featured strong offensive performances from both sides, with Liberty outhitting UNC by a margin of 11 to 9. However, the Lady Flames left eight runners on base and committed two errors during the contest.
North Carolina took an early lead with Shelby Barbee’s three-run homer in the first inning and extended it throughout the game. Despite home runs from Dani Lee, Alexia Carrasquillo, and Paige Doerr for Liberty, UNC maintained control. The Lady Flames narrowed the gap late with two-run homers by Carrasquillo and Doerr in the seventh inning before Brooke Roberts ended the rally with a popout.
Carly Maxton earned her ninth win of the season for UNC after pitching five and two-thirds innings, allowing two runs on seven hits. Kendall Frost finished for UNC but gave up four runs in relief. Camden Anders started for Liberty but was charged with five runs over two innings.
Ella Fox had her first career three-hit game against her former team by going 3-for-4 for Liberty. Other notable performances included Sanaa Thompson and Rayna Blackwell of UNC each recording a double, homerun, three RBI and two runs scored; Lee went 2-for-4 with a homerun for Liberty; Gabby Mike became the first Lady Flame this season to strike out all three batters faced in one inning.
North Carolina now leads their all-time series against Liberty in softball by fifteen wins to four. The visiting team has won each of their last five meetings since 2022. Looking ahead, Liberty will travel to Springfield, Missouri for a three-game series against Missouri State.
